title: Add CSV rerun evidence quick buttons
summary: Added CSV Rerun subtab quick buttons for rerun manifests, run logs, latest stdout/stderr, active jobs, and recent rerun command history.
reason: CSV rerun policy failures can be recorded in rerun manifests, run logs, active job records, or command history instead of normal file failure markers, so operators need direct read/open access from the CSV Rerun workflow.
behavior_before: The CSV Rerun subtab showed rerun state/history and row actions, but policy-failure evidence required navigating to Diagnostics, command history, or manifest paths manually.
behavior_after: The CSV Rerun subtab exposes read-only quick buttons that open the latest loaded rerun manifest, run logs, latest stdout/stderr, active jobs, and render recent rerun-related command history in the detail panel. Selecting the CSV Rerun tab refreshes read-only rerun results.
tests_added: Extended Queue/Launch static assertions for CSV rerun quick-button IDs and read/open route usage.
Extended browser-backed Launch/Queue readiness smoke to assert CSV rerun evidence buttons render.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static_queue tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static_launch tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q - failed on pre-existing unrelated assertions in test_application_facade_web_static: Launch tab order string and pending-publish allowed target local_file.
rollback_plan: Revert the CSV rerun quick-button markup, Queue/CSV Rerun JS handlers, Queue tab read-only refresh, CSS action-row styling, related static/browser smoke assertions, and regenerated summaries.
